name: Alex Mann
source:
Major: Graphic Design

If there's a way to be happy go-lucky and sharp at the same time, Alex surely knows about it! This otter has a knick for Photography and enjoys a good lense as much as the top-40 song of the moment. The off-paced and sometimes strange smile he gives on his jokes can change the whole meaning of any statement. Any weird statement, that is.

[From [url=http://corruptpolygons.com/]Corrupt Polygons[/url]]
